mapper.select: select count(*) as approved_cnt, count(*) filter (where e.effective_date < cast(#{today} as date)) as past_cnt, count(*) filter (where e.cust_approval_req_yn = 'Y' and e.cust_approval_status <> 'APPROVED') as cust_wait_cnt, count(*) filter (where e.apply_cond = 'STOCK_OUT') as stock_out_cnt from plm_eco e where e.status = 'APPROVED'
select e.eco_no, e.title, e.effective_date from plm_eco e where e.status = 'APPROVED' order by e.effective_date, e.eco_id limit #{limit}

select (select count(*) from plm_ppap p join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = p.eco_id where p.status = 'SUBMITTED' and e.status <> 'CANCELLED') as ppap_cnt, (select count(*) from plm_pcn n join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = n.eco_id where n.status = 'SENT' and n.response_due < cast(#{today} as date) and e.status <> 'CANCELLED') as pcn_overdue_cnt

select x.kind, x.no, x.eco_no, x.cust_cd, x.day from ( select 'PCN' as kind, 1 as ord, n.pcn_no as no, e.eco_no, c.cust_cd, n.response_due as day, n.pcn_id as id from plm_pcn n join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = n.eco_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = n.cust_id where n.status = 'SENT' and n.response_due < cast(#{today} as date) and e.status <> 'CANCELLED' union all select 'PPAP', 2, e.eco_no, e.eco_no, c.cust_cd, p.submitted_on, p.ppap_id from plm_ppap p join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = p.eco_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id where p.status = 'SUBMITTED' and e.status <> 'CANCELLED' ) x order by x.ord, x.day, x.id limit #{limit}

select e.eco_id, e.eco_no, e.title, e.effective_date, e.owner_id from plm_eco e where e.status = 'APPROVED' and e.effective_date < cast(#{today} as date) order by e.effective_date, e.eco_id limit #{limit}

select n.pcn_id, n.pcn_no, e.eco_no, c.cust_cd, n.response_due, e.owner_id from plm_pcn n join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = n.eco_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = n.cust_id where n.status = 'SENT' and n.response_due < cast(#{today} as date) and e.status <> 'CANCELLED' order by n.response_due, n.pcn_id limit #{limit}

select n.pcn_id, n.pcn_no, e.eco_no, c.cust_cd, n.response_due, e.owner_id from plm_pcn n join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = n.eco_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = n.cust_id where n.status = 'SENT' and n.response_due >= cast(#{today} as date) and n.response_due <= cast(#{until} as date) and e.status <> 'CANCELLED' order by n.response_due, n.pcn_id limit #{limit}
